name: Iris
tagline: Control a computer with eyes and voice: gaze to point, speak to click, scroll and type.
problem: People who cannot use their hands, or want hands-free use, lack simple control methods.
solution: Webcam eye tracking moves the pointer and offline speech recognition handles commands for clicking, scrolling and typing.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a button and say "click".

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “JT Award for Future Impact” among 124 submissions.

lessons: Hands-free control with commodity hardware is a credible accessibility pitch.
